the proposed system can be used as a macroscopic brain model and can reproduce the functions of consciousness.

the realization of a brain like AI system with consciousness and the development of a theory of consciousness from an information perspective.
the design of a human like artificial consciousness, which can be applied to the realization of human like AI systems, such as a robot with a sense of self.
the realization of a brain like AI system which can be applied to the realization of human like AI, and is a step toward the realization of a conscious AI system.
